answer: An farming party running 83 aliases hence needs 50 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are logged in ivory, expire in knoll, and spiral lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1642 identities would post 2217 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
